description: This file defines a base class for Whisper-based speech-to-text services, including language mapping, metrics handling, and transcription logic.

classes.name: BaseWhisperSTTService
classes.description: A base class for Whisper API speech-to-text services, providing common functionality such as language handling, metrics, and transcription.

methods.name: language_to_whisper_language
methods.description: Maps a pipecat Language enum to Whisper API language code.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Whisper STT service with model, API key, language, and other settings.

methods.name: set_model
methods.description: Sets the model name for transcription.

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to a service-specific language code.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles a transcription result with tracing (to be implemented).

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Performs speech-to-text transcription on audio data, yielding frames.

methods.name: _transcribe
methods.description: Abstract method to transcribe audio, to be implemented by subclasses.
